articles.title: India vs New Zealand 3rd T20I: Match Date, Time, Live Streaming & More
articles.description: IND vs NZ 3rd T20I: India are one victory away from sealing the five-match T20I series against New Zealand as the teams prepare for the third encounter. After two thrilling finishes in Christchurch, the action now shifts to Wellington, where the visitors will have their first opportunity to clinch the series. The opening two games have showcased India’s ability to hold their nerve under pressure. New Zealand will be desperate to respond on home soil and keep the contest alive. India vs New Zealand 3rd T20I: Match Date & Time The IND vs NZ 3rd T20I is scheduled to begin Tuesday, October 27, 12:30 PM IST at Wellington’s Henry Stadium. IND vs NZ 3rd T20I: TV & Live Streaming Details Indian viewers can watch the India vs New Zealand third T20I live on Sony Sports Network television channels. Digital streaming will be available through the Sony LIV app or website via a paid subscription. Wellington Pitch Report: What Can Players Expect? The surface at the Henry Stadium is expected to offer early assistance to fast bowlers, with bounce and movement available for those using the new ball. Batting conditions may become more favourable as the innings progresses, potentially creating opportunities for a substantial total. Wind and humidity could influence the opening overs, making the toss an important factor. Bowling first may appeal to the captain winning the toss, particularly if the conditions help seamers early on. Chasing could also be an attractive option at the venue. India vs New Zealand: How the First Two T20Is Unfolded India have taken a 2-0 lead, but neither victory came easily. In the series opener at Christchurch’s Hagley Oval, New Zealand posted 226 runs. India chased down the imposing target with just two deliveries remaining. The second match was equally close. New Zealand set India a target of 181, but the visitors once again held their nerve, reaching the total with one ball to spare. Another win in Wellington would put the series beyond New Zealand’s reach.

articles.title: 'Ooppss': Suryakumar Yadav Reacts After Fan Gets Hit By Baseball At MLBx Mumbai Event
articles.description: Suryakumar Yadav has responded after a female spectator shared footage of an unexpected incident at the MLBx Mumbai event, where she appeared to be struck by a baseball hit by the Indian cricketer. The video made its way across social media, prompting the India star and his wife, Devisha Shetty, to check on the fan’s well-being. The clip showed the aftermath of the incident, with the spectator receiving assistance for an injury to her left arm. The moment quickly attracted attention online, with Suryakumar himself stepping into the comments after coming across the post. What Did Suryakumar Yadav Say To The Fan? Embed Instagram Post The former India T20I captain left a comment on the fan’s video, asking about her condition and expressing hope that she was alright. "Ooppss hope you okay?" His wife, Devisha also reacted to the footage, joining her husband in checking on the spectator. Her message reflected concern over whether the impact had left the fan in pain. "Oh nooo hope it’s not hurting too bad" The couple’s responses came after the video showed the fan being attended to following the incident. A visible mark could be seen on her left bicep, while a man applied an ice pack to the affected area. Stadium personnel were also seen helping her with pain-relief sprays. Suryakumar Yadav’s MLBx Mumbai Appearance Suryakumar Yadav was among the prominent names at MLBx: Mumbai, a promotional baseball event that brought together personalities from cricket, baseball and softball. The competition featured a fast-paced three-on-three format, with participants displaying their hitting skills in front of an enthusiastic crowd. The New York Yankees team, featuring Suryakumar as an MLB India ambassador alongside baseball legend Nick Swisher and MVP Rachel Garcia, claimed the title on Saturday. The event aimed to bring baseball closer to Indian audiences by blending international stars with local sporting interest.

Uttarakhand to host 100-mile Himalayan Endurance Ultra Run from Mana Pass to Auli next May: CM Dhami
articles.description: Uttarakhand plans to organize a 100-mile Himalayan endurance ultra run in May next year. The race will start at Mana Pass and conclude at Auli after passing through Badrinath and Joshimath. Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami highlighted the event's role in promoting adventure tourism and supporting local economies. The government aims to create sustainable livelihood opportunities through tourism in border areas.
